transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Marshal. I heard the tape. He didn't sound misled. He sounded like he was counting trucks.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: Sera. Varda trainee, checking in. One of three. The other two are for after.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: He's down. His relay is dark. Every harbour on the coast is answering. You're on every receiver from the rim to the sea. Say it your way.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: This is Varda trainee, transmitting in the clear. The Air Marshal is down. The emergency is over. It never started.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: The orders were forged. The names were dead men's. An orchard was burned for a seed tin. Teal flew the pass so the trucks could get out.

transcript.speaker: TRAINEE
transcript.text: His name was Teal. He was not a deserter. Amend your records. For Teal. For the rim. We are coming home.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Varda trainee, Varda Control. Check-in received. Two of three. Come home and make the third in person.

transcript.speaker: TEAL
transcript.text: ...the sky will still be there.

transcript.speaker: LOG
transcript.text: VARDA RIM ROSTER. TEAL: KILLED IN ACTION, NOT DESERTED. INSTRUCTOR'S CHAIR: FILLED.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: High contacts are guiding the patrols. The trucks need that sky clear.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The road is open. Count the trucks at Varda.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fuel tanks only. The grain silos beside them feed families.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Vulture flight inbound. Leave the works. Survive; this is no duel.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: You are clear. I kept his orders on tape.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Iron Coast ahead. Ships and tankers; leave the market clear.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Harbour traffic copied. We can follow the orders inland.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Copy before you cut. We need the signature, not just wreckage.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Guns have the ridge. Take the canyon.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: I am staying in the tower. Keep the bombers away from the transmitter.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Thirty-five seconds sent. Two garrisons are answering.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Green beacon is ours. Clear the guns above the beach.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The landing is through. There is smoke over Teklan.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Keep the valley between you and the long-range guns.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: The corridor is open. Two civilian flights are ready.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: One airliner cannot climb. Watch both altitude bands.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Both flights are clear. I have a name for that handwriting.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Eight towers. The command array is his; the crater is your way in.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Ejection marked. Marines are moving.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Jammers in the ravine. Clear the plane a channel.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Fighters beyond the fog. Keep them off the evidence plane.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Missiles low over the ice. The dish must keep talking.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Archive received. Order zero-zero-zero-one. Rusk.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Loyalist troops below. Keep Rusk's armour off their streets.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Bombers incoming. They are turning on the city.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Clear the bunkers ahead of the column.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Both squads answering from the streets. Parliament has a road home.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Rusk leads four wingmen. Vulture Lead is back over the capital.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: He left his wing. Rusk is running for the coast.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Generators first. Then the central vent. Leave yourself a way out.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: You are clear. His loop has stopped. Rusk is coming up alone.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: Six bombers, our paint and codes. Stop them before the north coast.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Follow the power line north. Their bombers are parked on the farm.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: FARM CONTROL: Bombers, start engines! Get them off the ground!

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Four down. Their guns are still up, watch the base edges.

transcript.speaker: BROADCAST
transcript.text: FARM CONTROL: The pads are burning. Nobody takes off from here.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: LANTERN 2: One bomber left. Finish it, trainee.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Enemy airspace. Site one is on the ridge north-west of you.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: LANTERN 2: Dome down. Good hit, trainee.

transcript.speaker: SERA
transcript.text: SERA: Five domes down. Site two is on the saddle west-north-west.

transcript.speaker: MARINE
transcript.text: LANTERN 2: One dome left. Finish it and we go home.

transcript.speaker: RIM TOWER
transcript.text: RIM TOWER: Trainee, gear check. Cleared to land, runway three-six.

transcript.speaker: RIM TOWER
transcript.text: RIM TOWER: Runway in sight. You're on the centreline.

transcript.speaker: RIM TOWER
transcript.text: RIM TOWER: Short final. Glide path is good, hold it there.

transcript.speaker: RIM TOWER
transcript.text: RIM TOWER: Touchdown. Nice and gentle.

transcript.speaker: RIM TOWER
transcript.text: RIM TOWER: Welcome home. Sera wants that film before you unstrap.
